writer.kind: native exact full rewrite from final body

measurement_source.seed: First16 SHA256 bytes of compact JSON [namespace,stage,*record_key,probe,purpose,channel], little endian, PCG64.
measurement_source.coupling: Regimes share base draws and injuries. Matched copies first cue birth/noise to second; independent retains both. Writer/evaluation use distinct purpose keys; unchanged and rewritten evaluations share B.
measurement_source.injury: 24 distinct uniformly selected non-port cells/read; all three2x2 ports protected.

forcing.future_seed_contract: First 16 SHA256 bytes of compact JSON [future_namespace,stage,*record_key,generation,purpose,channel], little endian, PCG64. Generations 15..32 use writer purpose, generation 33 evaluation. Injury and forcing channels are disjoint.
forcing.future_noise_and_injury: Same base injury masks and random draws across matched/independent regimes. Each read has 24 distinct non-port injuries. Matched copies cue0 birth and ongoing noise to cue1; independent keeps both. Fresh body each read; each regime propagates its own outgoing packets.

cohort.selection: All 63 previously selected records, unchanged; 31 currently failing and 32 currently passing. Both classes present in every block. The original selection preceded all measurement probes.
cohort.repeat: First pre-existing measurement repeat only: successor probe indices 0..31 and direct indices 0..7. No averaging, repeat selection, recalibration or refitting.
cohort.cost_accounting: No new acquisition or measurement reads. Reuse is not free measurement: source acquisition 14336 native reads, source measurement 18144 native reads; first-repeat forecasts use 9072 of those measurement reads.

outcome.endpoint: Native task success in a fresh terminal body reading the g32 outgoing packet, after18 full original-writer rebuilds from g14. All four task-aligned cue/port means strictly>.25. Terminal read outgoing packet discarded; failure earlier in lineage does not stop a path.
outcome.continuation_audit: One key-only SHA256-ranked record per block, both regimes, every one of18 rewrites and terminal read. Flat path propagates its own packets; bodies,windows,outgoing must be bitwise equal.
outcome.claims: Terminal reconstruction, not uninterrupted function, autonomous apparatus maintenance, a universal probability law or RDT-specific novelty.

analysis.estimand: Equal acquisition-block and current-expression-class weight over the selected precision panel. Each record weight within block is 1/(2*n_block_class). This differs from the cancelled all-64-record block estimand.
analysis.formula: For each block, mean Brier in current_fail and current_pass strata, then their unweighted mean. Equal mean across 16 blocks. Rival-minus-candidate paired block contrasts.
analysis.interval: Mean +/- t.ppf(.975,15)*sample block SD/sqrt(16). Lower>margin supports, upper<=margin rejects the selected-panel advantage; otherwise unresolved.
analysis.joint: All four advantages must be supported for joint pilot support. Intersection-union claim; component intervals not simultaneous.
analysis.diagnostics: Weighted ten-bin calibration with probability one included in last bin; both current-expression strata and history counts. No subgroup rescue.
analysis.limits: Prospective outcomes for an already inspected and selected precision panel. Sixteen blocks have limited power. No claim of representative all-record performance, independent laboratory replication, externally registered confirmation, or RDT-specific novelty.
analysis.completion: All 63 records in both regimes required. No partial inferential verdict, extension or replacement.

barrier: Validate all source hashes, exact first-repeat extraction, all scalar fixed predictions and selected packet identities; seal all 126 forecasts before any future read.
audit: One key-only SHA256 ranked record per block, both regimes and all 19 native reads, with flat path propagating its own outputs; independent final scoring.

exposure.precision_panel: All 63 selections, repeated predictions and precision results already inspected; zero future outcomes in verified source completion
exposure.cancelled_304_job: Stopped by user before any continuation; one complete block of measurements preserved and excluded from this pilot
